description: Make Trellis project updates ownership-aware for mixed generated assets
changelog:
**Ownership-aware update fixes:**
- Trellis updates preserve project-owned top-level YAML sections and Codex TOML keys/tables that are not declared by the current template.
- AGENTS.md updates replace only the valid TRELLIS managed block when surrounding project prose is unchanged.
- No project migration is required.
notes: Run npm install -g @pennixrv/trellis@beta then trellis update. No --migrate required.
